deploybot: PRE-RUN CHECK: blocked deploy to prod for release window 2026-06-15T09:00Z. Issue: env parity failure detected for service=model-router (secret=credentials_blob).
dana: wtf — I thought we standardized secret formats last quarter. what broke?
rafael: quick summary: staging contains YAML map saved as plaintext, prod contains the same data base64-encoded as a single blob. runtime expects a map.
claire: that matches the nullpointer we saw in yesterday's canary (failed to parse).
release-bot: unchanged files in release: routing improvements + model pin. The failing change is independent of routing, but preflight flags it.
ops-bot: policy: block_on_secret_encoding_mismatch = true for prod. Manual migration allowed with two approvers.
dana: options? roll back the routing change, or fix secrets.
rafael: we can: (A) backfill prod to decoded YAML map, (B) change runtime to accept both encodings, (C) add a secrets-transform layer in the platform.
claire: (A) is fastest. I'll volunteer to run migration if ops gives greenlight.
dana: we have a 3-hour change window. customers expect the routing pin to land today. prefer minimal blast radius.
release-bot: proposal: split release — promote routing and model pin to prod but keep model-router image pinned to previous stable for now. Then run secret backfill and a quick canary for model-router only.
ops-bot: approved split strategy. Must document rollback procedure before proceeding.
dana: can someone write the migration script? I can run it.
rafael: I pushed scripts/encode_fix/convert_credentials.sh to repo — simple decode+write. usage: `convert_credentials.sh --service model-router --dry-run`.
claire: running dry-run now:
```
$ ./scripts/encode_fix/convert_credentials.sh --service model-router --dry-run
DRYRUN: 4 secrets would be decoded to YAML map and replaced. No changes applied.
```
claire: prepping backups to SSM at /backups/model-router/2026-06-15T0900.
dana: make sure to annotate secrets with `redwood.com/encoding=decoded-v1` after migration for audit.
ops-bot: require two approvers: @dana and @rafael. Please ack.
dana: ack.
rafael: ack. go ahead, claire.
claire: applying migration now. leaving note in incident runbook.
claire: applied migration and wrote backups. added annotation to all kube secrets.
claire: re-running deploybot preflight...
deploybot: PRECHECK: secret encoding parity OK for model-router. additional check: quick smoke hitting healthcheck endpoint returned 200.
dana: great. promote routing changes to prod excluding model-router image update.
release-bot: promoted non-model-router artifacts. model-pin remains pinned to previous sha until we run full canary.
rafael: start model-router canary (image=redwood/model-router:2026-06-15-rc3 pin=sha256:ef01). 10% traffic for 10m, then 50% if stable.
ops-bot: monitor for parsing errors and 5xx. Alert if >0.5% error rate.
claire: canary healthy at 10m. no errors. promoting to 50%.
dana: after 20m at 50% looks stable. promote to 100%.
release-bot: model-router promoted to prod. release marked shipped.
dana: release notes: "Fix: normalize credentials encoding for model-router secrets in prod (decoded YAML). Added `redwood.com/encoding=decoded-v1` annotation. Backups stored at /backups/model-router/2026-06-15T0900."
